Welcome to Rainbow DIY Family ❤️
On this channel, I create funny and original animated videos using characters I design entirely by hand. Each video is made with care and creativity:

🎨 First, I hand-molded the clay blocks on my tablet in my Studio
✂️ Then, I use Final Cut Pro to cut out characters and bring them to life with custom edits.
🎤 I add my own voice acting, video effects, and carefully selected music from YouTube’s Creative Studio.

Unlike typical reaction channels, my content is transformed with storytelling, commentary, and humor – offering a completely new take on the original.

⏱ Each video takes around 24 hours to produce, ensuring a distinct difference from the original and giving viewers something truly entertaining and new.

❗Important: If you're the original creator of any video I reacted to and would prefer it not be used, please reach out to me directly. I respect all creators and will gladly resolve any concerns ❤️
